review_candidates.title: Data Engineer - Enterprise & Infrastructure
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The role: Reporting to the Manager IT Projects and Applications, the Integration and Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines, ETL processes, and system integrations that enable the high-speed railway organization to move, transform, and store data reliably across its application landscape. You are successful when data flows reliably between systems, pipelines are well built and maintainable, and the organization can count on clean and timely data
eligibility_evidence: Familiar with cloud data services, particularly in Azure, and comfortable working across hybrid environments.

This role is for someone who finds satisfaction in making data move reliably and cleanly, cares about the quality of what they build, and wants to be at the center of how a major national infrastructure project turns operational data into business insight.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of how the organization turns raw operational data into trusted, accessible information for reporting and business intelligence. Support the onboarding of new data sources and application integrations, working from business requirements to deliver solutions that are fit for purpose and built to standard. Collaborate with business stakeholders and application teams to understand data needs, translating requirements into practical engineering solutions that deliver measurable value. Your profile/ qualifications: Formal education in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field is welcome but what matters most is demonstrated hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations. 2–5 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or systems integration in an enterprise environment.
